notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.content:
Major rebalancing and bugfixes

+ [b]Rebalanced homing:[/b] Homing shots now accelerate towards targets in addition to bending towards them to make them more effective at reaching targets. Homing shots are also able to target bugs again and are far more accurate against them.

Bug Fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed robots performing their on-death attack being able to collide with some enemy types.
[*] Fixed robots causing a lag spike the first time they attempt their on-death attack in a game.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
Small UI Changes

[list]
[*] Added difficulty descriptions, making clear what each offers without trial and error.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
More bug fixes and adjustments

[list]
[*] Fixed Overview leaderboard being blank if you have never played a particular difficulty.
[*] Adjusted difficulty of some endless loop waves.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain loop waves would erroneously combine together, creating a much more difficult super wave.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.content:
Fixed a small bug and made some adjustments.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where if a shooter made physical contact with a player, it would stop rotating to face them forever. This would eventually cause the shooter to leave the border and not return, soft locking the player.
[*] Made distance-based turn speed more efficient.
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of some late game waves and early looping waves.
[*] Added current version number to main menu.
[/list]
